top_signals.title: Holiday Inn owner suffers Middle East slowdown as Iran war hits tourism
top_signals.summary: The owner of Holiday Inn has suffered a slump in revenue at its Middle Eastern business as the Iran war knocked the region’s tourist economy.  Intercontinental Hotels Group (IHG) said its revenue per available room in the Middle East slipped by 19 per cent in the three months to June. top_signals.title: Tencent’s WorkBuddy Sparks AI Turnaround Hopes After Stock Rout
top_signals.summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd.’s early success with WorkBuddy may give the Chinese Internet giant a chance to catch up after lagging peers in the artificial intelligence race for the past few years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Wipro’s Nifty Exit Reflects Waning Clout of Indian IT Giants
top_signals.summary: Wipro Ltd.’s exit from India’s Nifty 50 to make way for exchange operator BSE Ltd. marks more than a benchmark reshuffle. It captures the shift from an outsourcing-led boom to one powered by the growing ranks of investors in the nation’s $5-trillion stock market.
